slides.texte_overlay:
how to be the person
everyone remembers

walk in in a good mood

before you enter, take three slow breaths and decide to enjoy yourself. people feel your energy before you say a word, and a warm mood spreads through a room quickly.

make it about them

ask people what they're excited about and stay on that topic. people forget most of what you say, but they always remember how you made them feel while talking.

remember their name

use each person's name once in the conversation and once as you leave. it's a small thing almost nobody does, and it makes people feel truly seen and valued.

always bring a story

spend 5 minutes a day learning something fascinating, a lost city or a strange animal, and you'll always have a story. people remember whoever taught them something surprising.
slides.texte_sophia:
always bring a story

learn one fascinating thing a day, a lost city or a strange animal. the Sophia app turns it into one short lesson a day, and people always remember whoever told the best story.

slides.texte_overlay:
end on a warm note

close every conversation with something kind about what they told you. people remember the last moment most, so make it warm, genuine and entirely about them.
